text: …　ことわるって　かお　してんな　それなら…！

structure.jp: …　ことわるって　かお　してんな
structure.en: ...you've got a face that says 'I refuse'

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: ことわるって　かお
patterns.explanation: って is the casual short form of という and tells you what the next thing says or is about. ことわるって　かお = 'a face that says "I refuse"'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: してん is a rough, squashed form of している, which shows something is going on right now. かお　してん = 'are making a face'.

patterns.name: 〜な (remark)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker is noticing something and remarking on it, like 'huh' or 'I see'. してんな = 'you're making (that face), huh'.
